title: [jdk-dev] CFV: New JDK Committer: George Adams
content:
Thread: CFV: New JDK Committer: George Adams
List: jdk-dev@openjdk.org | Messages: 1+

[OP] I hereby nominate George Adams, gdams[0], to JDK Committer. George manages the Java team at Microsoft. George has contributed at least 11 changes so far to the JDK project [1] and is an active contributor to the jdk-updates project, where he is already a Comitter. George intends to contribute more to JDK mainline. Getting Comitter status seems a natural progression for him. Votes are due by 15:00 CEST on Thursday 11th of June 2026. Only current JDK Committers [2] are eligible to vote on this nomination. Votes must be cast in the open by replying to this mailing list. For Lazy Consensus voting instructions, see [3]. Thanks, Severin [0] https://openjdk.org/census#gdams [1] https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Aopenjdk%2Fjdk+author-name%3A%22George+Ada... [2] https://openjdk.org/census [3] https://openjdk.org/projects/#committer-vote
